base.rule: No >=20% adjacent gap in baseline percentiles 90–99.99; maximize 256-bin log-norm Otsu between-class variance. Descriptive split, not proof of a separate artifact mode. The unimodal Otsu split is not used to label artifacts. Apply the large-model cutoff for a common absolute-scale comparison.
